n: Extension of Teachable Machine (GenAI project Finland)
t: An online machine learning demo listed by AI4K12 as an extension of Teachable Machine.
steps: Open it in a browser on one computer.
Spend ten minutes testing what it does.
Compare it with the standard Google Teachable Machine.
Ask IT to check the web address.
Look for who runs the site and read any privacy page.
Decide whether it fits your lesson before sharing it.
